name: single-stage-reflectron
description: Closed form: 2L/v + 2v/a with L = 4d. Ideal single-stage reflectron at the first-order energy focus, where the total field-free path is four penetration depths. Analytic flight time 10.1805 us for m/z 500 at 4 keV: 2L/v of drift plus 2v/a of turnaround. Arrival time is flat to first order in energy, so sweeping the acceptance moves it by only the second-order term. The mirror depth and the cap potential are declared parameters, so this model can be swept and optimised as it stands.
